model.name: Phantom-coverage-at-scale — every gate is invoked-by-a-runner or marked-not-invoked-with-reason, count reported (discovered-not-hand-listed)
model.description: PHANTOM-COVERAGE-AT-SCALE: a gate that is committed but NEVER INVOKED by a runner silently means 'gated WHEN A HUMAN REMEMBERS' — so it rots invisibly and a real breach reaches production. MEASURED 2026-08-31 (robbin-req, first-hand): 272 test/visual/r*.mjs gates exist on disk; only 4 are referenced by ANY runner (r3729/r4011/r4012/r4019, all in gate:device:live:raw); ci:gates:raw is ALL check:/bite: scripts with ZERO visual gates => 268 un-invoked. That is why a 250x perf breach reached Tron. The only two runners are ci:gates:raw + gate:device:live:raw. INVARIANT: every gate is EITHER invoked by a runner OR explicitly MARKED not-invoked WITH a reason, and the COUNT of un-invoked is REPORTED — discovered-not-hand-listed (glob all r*.mjs), so no gate rots silently. Sibling of R37.28 (gate-INVOCATION-mechanics: a spawned gate returns a real result) but a DISTINCT property: invocation-EXISTENCE/WIRING (a gate must be wired to a runner or marked-not). Same scale-invariant shape as R37.30 server-compute-flat (coverage-flat + compute-flat as the corpus grows = one family). An O(total)/uninvoked defect is INVISIBLE behind small fixtures / a human-run gate — it only appears at scale.

discoverySource.measured: 272 test/visual/r*.mjs on disk; 4 runner-referenced (r3729/r4011/r4012/r4019, gate:device:live:raw); ci:gates:raw = 0 visual gates => 268 un-invoked. r301 = Sprint-30-hardcoded + in no runner (would RED if run). r241/r245 = known-broken-invocation (count 2).
discoverySource.note: Relayed number was ~180; MEASURED 272 (measure-wins; encode the measured figure).

model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED (scenario-first #126; DO-NOT-BUILD per PO no-urgency; lint check:gate-invocation not yet built, no stub RED observed).
model.crossRefNote: Sibling of R37.28 (gate-invocation-MECHANICS: spawned gate returns a real result) — DISTINCT property: invocation-EXISTENCE/WIRING. Reuses R37.25 coverage-self-report + discovered-not-hand-listed. Same scale-invariant family as R37.30 server-compute-flat (coverage-flat + compute-flat). Actor-attribution AC ties the display-message/R40.48-hook mis-attribution hazard.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every test/visual/r*.mjs gate is EITHER invoked by a runner (ci:gates:raw or gate:device:live:raw — the only two, grepped) OR explicitly MARKED not-invoked WITH a reason. A gate that is neither invoked nor marked => RED. 'Gated' must mean 'runs in CI', never 'runs when a human remembers'.

gateRef.assertion: each r*.mjs is in a runner OR in the marked-not-invoked list with a reason; neither => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): plant a gate neither invoked nor marked => RED, before the lint counts as wired

acceptanceCriteria.text: The COUNT of un-invoked gates is REPORTED every run (self-report, R37.25 lineage), never silently drained. Today: 272 on disk / 4 invoked / 268 un-invoked. The number is published so a narrowing of coverage is visible.

gateRef.assertion: reported un-invoked count == (globbed r*.mjs) minus (runner-referenced) minus (marked-not); a false-drained count => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a false-drained count (report fewer than measured) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The gate set is DISCOVERED by glob of test/visual/r*.mjs, never a hand-list; a NEW gate committed but absent from every runner AND from the marked-not list surfaces automatically (divergence). A hand-maintained gate roster rots exactly like the boot/owner hand-lists.

gateRef.assertion: a newly-added r*.mjs not in any runner and not marked => flagged; the evaluated set == the globbed set

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: add a new r*.mjs absent from runners + marked-list => divergence flags it

acceptanceCriteria.text: The un-invoked set keeps its categories DISTINCT (merging destroys the number's meaning): STALE-HARDCODED-UNINVOKED (e.g. r301 pinned to Sprint-30 literals, in no runner, would RED if run) vs KNOWN-BROKEN-INVOCATION (e.g. r241/r245, count stays 2). Each category is counted separately; a merge that hides one behind the other => RED.

gateRef.assertion: stale-hardcoded-uninvoked and known-broken-invocation are reported as SEPARATE counts; merging them => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a stale-hardcoded gate counted under known-broken (or vice-versa) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: A gate cannot rot by hardcoding: gate assertions derive their targets (sprint/version/paths) from the live source (deriveSprintPin / package.json / structuralDiscover), never a pinned literal. r301 (Sprint-30 hardcode) is the exemplar defect. A gate with a pinned era-literal in an assertion position => flagged for derive-repair.

gateRef.assertion: a gate asserting against a hardcoded sprint/version literal => flagged; a derived assertion => pass

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a gate with a hardcoded sprint/version literal => flagged for derive-repair

acceptanceCriteria.text: A gate that reports its ACTOR must attribute the REAL actor, not an ambient/attached value. MEASURED root: tmux display-message resolves to the ATTACHED pane, not the acting pane (it mislabelled robbin-req as robbin-expert@v60211; the R40.48 commit-attribution hook mis-attributes the PO's commits to robbin-expert the same way). A gate/hook that misattributes its actor reports the WRONG owner => the coverage/ownership report is a lie. Actor resolves via pane.self / the acting identity, never the attached pane.

gateRef.assertion: a gate/hook deriving actor from the attached pane (display-message) => flagged; actor derived from the acting identity (pane.self) => pass

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a gate/hook resolving actor via display-message (attached pane) => flagged

acceptanceCriteria.text: STUB-MUST-FAIL (prove-the-prover): plant an un-invoked gate (a new r*.mjs in no runner, not marked) => the invocation lint REDs; wire it or mark it with a reason => GREEN. A phantom-coverage guard that cannot go RED on a planted un-invoked gate certifies nothing.

gateRef.assertion: planted un-invoked gate => RED; wired-or-marked => GREEN; weakened lint => suite RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): the lint's own stub (planted un-invoked gate) observed RED before it counts as wired

acceptanceCriteria.text: STATED==IMPLEMENTED: the invariant as written (every gate invoked-or-marked, count reported, categories distinct, actor correct) equals what the lint enforces — no AC names a property the lint does not check.

gateRef.assertion: every AC here maps to a check in the lint; an AC with no enforcing check => RED (R40.54 failable-family)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: an AC here with no mapped check in the lint => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: PHANTOM-COVERAGE, ONE SHAPE / TWO LAYERS (PO 2026-08-31): the same disease as un-invoked gates, one layer up — an AC that EXISTS on a requirement but has NO implementing TASK 'looks covered, nothing implements it'. Exemplar: R40.62 AC-render-diagram-file-artefact existed since commit 1cbe69cd2 with no task (metaFindingAcNeverTasked). The guard DISCOVERS un-tasked ACs the SAME way it discovers un-invoked gates: glob all requirement ACs, and an AC not reachable from any Task's coveredRequirements-with-an-implementing-plan is REPORTED (with count), discovered-not-hand-listed. Un-invoked gate (a gate that never RUNS) and un-tasked AC (an AC that is never IMPLEMENTED) are two members of one phantom-coverage family: both read as coverage on a board and neither protects anything.

gateRef.assertion: an AC with no implementing task => reported as un-tasked (count published); an un-invoked gate => reported as un-invoked; same discovered-not-hand-listed sweep, two layers

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): mint an AC with no implementing task => the guard reports it un-tasked (a green board over an un-tasked AC => the AC fails)

model.phantomCoverageFamily: Named family (PO 2026-08-31): PHANTOM-COVERAGE = exists-on-the-board / protects-nothing. Members: (1) UN-INVOKED GATE — a test/visual gate committed but in no runner (272/4 measured); (2) UN-TASKED AC — an AC minted on a req but never given an implementing task (R40.62 diagram-artefact since 1cbe69cd2, metaFindingAcNeverTasked). One discovered-not-hand-listed shape, two layers. Sibling of R37.30 scale-invariance (compute-flat) — all three = a property that is INVISIBLE unless discovered by measuring, never by a hand-list.
model.strengthenLog: 2026-08-31 APPEND (PO): +AC-discovers-un-tasked-acs + phantomCoverageFamily note. APPEND-ONLY, 0 existing ACs touched. The un-tasked-AC layer came from the P4 finding (R40.62 AC never tasked) — the PO asked to encode it as the sibling of un-invoked-gate.
